title: Seoul mayor steps forward as conservatives seek unity
caption:
Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon is back in the spotlight after an appeals court overturned his political funding conviction. This legal win has sparked talk of a presidential run as he moves to unify the conservative party.

Source: Koreaherald - Seoul mayor steps forward as conservatives seek unity
